descriptionHtml:
HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Gaming Headset Noise Cancelling dtsX edition (DTS Headphone:X Spatial Audio / Large 50mm Dynamic Drivers / Bi-Directional Noise-Canceling Mic / Premium Memory Foam & Leatherette Earpads / Onboard Volume Controls / PC Splitter Included / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Experience superior acoustic precision and total noise isolation with the HyperX Cloud Stinger 2 Gaming Headset Noise Cancelling dtsX edition, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Upgraded with massive 50mm dynamic directional neodymium drivers delivering an expanded 10 Hz - 28 kHz frequency response and 97.5 dBSPL/mW sensitivity, this headset produces deep bass and crystal-clear highs. Outfitted with ultra-comfortable memory foam wrapped in premium leatherette ear cushions, an electret condenser bi-directional noise-canceling microphone, onboard volume controls, and a long 6.56ft cable with PC extension splitter, it delivers spatial immersion powered by DTS Headphone:X audio technology.
